card.name: Instruction verbs in clinical directions
card.fires_on: Action verbs such as evaluate, avoid, affect, ensure and diagnosed, placed right after a subject or adverb in clinical or health instructions. They often open a directive like 'Evaluate for signs of...'.

modes.label: Directive verbs
modes.description: A verb opens a warning or monitoring instruction, often at the start of a sentence.
modes.example: << Evaluate>> for signs of opioid withdrawal.

modes.label: Verb after adverb or modal
modes.description: A verb follows an adverb or modal such as promptly, regularly, will not or may.
modes.example: A treatment, promptly<< evaluate>> for gastrointestinal perforation.
